definitions.explanation: A place of worship in the Shinto religion, typically marked by a torii gate at the entrance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{正月|しょうがつ}→正月：01433_shougatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{神社|じんじゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}きます→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I go to the shrine on New Year's.
examples.notes: ⟦{初詣|はつもうで}→初詣：05804_hatsumoude⟧ - first shrine visit of the year

examples.japanese: {神社|じんじゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{お守|まも}り→お守り：05955_omamori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}いました→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought an amulet at the shrine.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{鳥居|とりい}→鳥居：05956_torii⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{神社|じんじゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{入|い}り{口|ぐち}→入り口：02507_iriguchi⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: That torii is the entrance to the shrine.

notes:
{神社|じんじゃ} is a Shinto shrine, distinct from Buddhist temples.

SHRINE vs TEMPLE:
- {神社|じんじゃ}: Shinto shrine (has torii gate)
- ⟦お{寺|てら}→お寺：23515_otera⟧/⟦{寺院|じいん}→寺院：00122_jiin⟧: Buddhist temple

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {神社|じんじゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参|まい}る→参る：01322_mairu⟧: to visit a shrine
- {神社|じんじゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{お参|まい}り→お参り：16837_omairi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to pray at a shrine
- ⟦{鳥居|とりい}→鳥居：05956_torii⟧: torii gate
- ⟦{お守|まも}り→お守り：05955_omamori⟧: amulet, charm
- ⟦{絵馬|えま}→絵馬：05957_ema⟧: votive tablet
- ⟦おみくじ→御神籤：05959_omikuji⟧: fortune slip
